requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area, so this is a direct >= filter on surface_area. The 15-person capacity is not converted to an area filter because no verified gross-property-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.

User wants the commercial unit located near parks. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74. Parks and green areas are explicitly requested, so the green category is activated.

Results are ordered by distance from that point, nearest first. No LIMIT is applied.
